nodes.name: Seyda Neen
nodes.description: Swamp-edge Census and Excise port where the pardoned prisoner steps off the Imperial ship under the gaze of the old lighthouse; first stop on every road to Balmora.

demographics.primary: Imperial customs clerks, Dunmer fishermen, freshly pardoned prisoners

nodes.customNotes: Swamp-edge Census and Excise port where the pardoned prisoner steps off the Imperial ship under the gaze of the old lighthouse; first stop on every road to Balmora.

nodes.name: Pelagiad
nodes.description: Walled Imperial farming town on the Ascadian road, its Fort Pelagiad garrison guarding the silt-road and the Halfway Tavern.

demographics.primary: Imperial settlers, Redguard caravaneers, Legion pickets

nodes.customNotes: Walled Imperial farming town on the Ascadian road, its Fort Pelagiad garrison guarding the silt-road and the Halfway Tavern.

nodes.name: Ebonheart
nodes.description: Seat of Duke Vedam Dren and Imperial authority on Vvardenfell, its Grand Council Chambers, Hawkmoth Legion Garrison and Chapels of the Eight overlooking the Vivec channel.

demographics.primary: Imperial Legion officers, Cult chaplains, East Empire Company factors

nodes.customNotes: Seat of Duke Vedam Dren and Imperial authority on Vvardenfell, its Grand Council Chambers, Hawkmoth Legion Garrison and Chapels of the Eight overlooking the Vivec channel.

nodes.name: Gnaar Mok
nodes.description: Rotting stilt-village on the Bitter Coast where smugglers, mudcrab hunters and a Hlaalu-run trading post cling to the swamp.

demographics.primary: Dunmer mudcrab hunters, Argonian laborers, rain-soaked tavern regulars

nodes.customNotes: Rotting stilt-village on the Bitter Coast where smugglers, mudcrab hunters and a Hlaalu-run trading post cling to the swamp.

nodes.name: Hla Oad
nodes.description: Fishing hamlet at the mouth of the Odai river whose docks pass illicit cargo toward Balmora under Hlaalu indifference.

demographics.primary: Fishing families, Argonian dockhands, smuggler middlemen

nodes.customNotes: Fishing hamlet at the mouth of the Odai river whose docks pass illicit cargo toward Balmora under Hlaalu indifference.

nodes.name: Balmora
nodes.description: Hlaalu commercial hub split by the Odai river; every guild keeps a hall here, and Caius Cosades keeps a quiet apartment above the South Wall.

demographics.primary: Hlaalu merchants, guild adventurers, Imperial immigrants

nodes.customNotes: Hlaalu commercial hub split by the Odai river; every guild keeps a hall here, and Caius Cosades keeps a quiet apartment above the South Wall.

nodes.name: Fort Moonmoth
nodes.description: Imperial Legion fortress on the Odai ford; staging ground for patrols, courier runs and the Legion's thin readiness against Ghostfence rumors.

demographics.primary: Legion auxiliaries, Imperial officers, pressed Dunmer scouts

nodes.customNotes: Imperial Legion fortress on the Odai ford; staging ground for patrols, courier runs and the Legion's thin readiness against Ghostfence rumors.

nodes.name: Arkngthand
nodes.description: Ruined Dwemer hall whose centrifuge chambers still turn; a favored dead-drop for Blades couriers, scavengers and Dwemer puzzle-box hunters.

demographics.primary: Dwemer automata, scavenger scholars, bandits

nodes.customNotes: Ruined Dwemer hall whose centrifuge chambers still turn; a favored dead-drop for Blades couriers, scavengers and Dwemer puzzle-box hunters.

nodes.name: Caldera
nodes.description: Imperial mining town under the Dwemer volcanic mouth whose ebony and glass operations are run by the East Empire Company with Hlaalu complicity.

demographics.primary: Imperial mine bosses, Dunmer laborers, Company clerks

nodes.customNotes: Imperial mining town under the Dwemer volcanic mouth whose ebony and glass operations are run by the East Empire Company with Hlaalu complicity.

nodes.name: Khuul
nodes.description: Isolated northwest fishing port and the departure point for ships to Solstheim and the northern sea road.

demographics.primary: Redoran fishers, Nordic sailors, smugglers

nodes.customNotes: Isolated northwest fishing port and the departure point for ships to Solstheim and the northern sea road.

nodes.name: Ald Velothi
nodes.description: Redoran outpost on the Azura's Coast watching the northern shore road, with a Temple outpost and the Outpost Hall for passing pilgrims.

demographics.primary: Redoran guard-captains, Temple pilgrims, hermit mages

nodes.customNotes: Redoran outpost on the Azura's Coast watching the northern shore road, with a Temple outpost and the Outpost Hall for passing pilgrims.

nodes.name: Gnisis
nodes.description: Fortress-temple town on the northern pilgrimage road; Gnisis Temple's Ordinators and the Madach Tradehouse bind Redoran honor to Temple ritual.

demographics.primary: Redoran-leaning Dunmer, Temple pilgrims, ashland traders

nodes.customNotes: Fortress-temple town on the northern pilgrimage road; Gnisis Temple's Ordinators and the Madach Tradehouse bind Redoran honor to Temple ritual.

nodes.name: Ald'ruhn
nodes.description: Redoran capital built within the shell of a giant emperor-crab, its Skar council hall, Manor District and Morag Tong shadow sharing one cramped ridge.

demographics.primary: Redoran warriors, Temple Ordinators, Ashlander visitors

nodes.customNotes: Redoran capital built within the shell of a giant emperor-crab, its Skar council hall, Manor District and Morag Tong shadow sharing one cramped ridge.

nodes.name: Urshilaku Camp
nodes.description: Seat of Ashkhan Sul-Matuul and Wise Woman Nibani Maesa; keepers of the Nerevarine prophecies and the first test of the Chosen One.

demographics.primary: Urshilaku Ashlanders, nomadic herders, tribal wise women

nodes.customNotes: Seat of Ashkhan Sul-Matuul and Wise Woman Nibani Maesa; keepers of the Nerevarine prophecies and the first test of the Chosen One.

nodes.name: Zainab Camp
nodes.description: Wind-whipped Ashlander camp on the northern ash-flats, a pragmatic tribe open to outlander trade and hostile to Dagoth husbands.

demographics.primary: Zainab Ashlanders, guar herders, mystic hunters

nodes.customNotes: Wind-whipped Ashlander camp on the northern ash-flats, a pragmatic tribe open to outlander trade and hostile to Dagoth husbands.

nodes.name: Maar Gan
nodes.description: Pilgrim town below the Ghostfence whose Temple shrines have fed on a thin pious trade since the blight storms began.

demographics.primary: Temple devotees, Redoran villagers, Ghostgate pilgrims

nodes.customNotes: Pilgrim town below the Ghostfence whose Temple shrines have fed on a thin pious trade since the blight storms began.

nodes.name: Ghostgate
nodes.description: Fortress-gate through the Ghostfence, the ward Vivec raised around Red Mountain; the Temple Ordinators hold it against blight and cult infiltration.

demographics.primary: Temple Ordinator wardens, Buoyant Armigers, ghost-guardians

nodes.customNotes: Fortress-gate through the Ghostfence, the ward Vivec raised around Red Mountain; the Temple Ordinators hold it against blight and cult infiltration.

nodes.name: Dagoth Ur Citadel Approach
nodes.description: Entrance to the volcano interior beyond the breached Ghostfence, where ash storms howl across the approaches to Dagoth Ur's citadels.

demographics.primary: Ash creatures, Sixth House cultists, corprus husks

nodes.customNotes: Entrance to the volcano interior beyond the breached Ghostfence, where ash storms howl across the approaches to Dagoth Ur's citadels.

nodes.name: Mount Kand
nodes.description: Wind-scoured ash slope on the Red Mountain flank, an old Daedric shrine site now contested between Ashlander hunters and corprus-bitten scouts.

demographics.primary: Erabenimsun hunters, Sixth House scouts, ash-wasted outlaws

nodes.customNotes: Wind-scoured ash slope on the Red Mountain flank, an old Daedric shrine site now contested between Ashlander hunters and corprus-bitten scouts.

nodes.name: Vivec City
nodes.description: The great canton-city of Vivec, floating the Palace and the Ministry of Truth over the Zafirbel Bay; its sea-wall cantons are the political body of Vvardenfell.

demographics.primary: Temple clergy, Great House factors, foreign merchants

nodes.customNotes: The great canton-city of Vivec, floating the Palace and the Ministry of Truth over the Zafirbel Bay; its sea-wall cantons are the political body of Vvardenfell.

nodes.name: Suran
nodes.description: Hlaalu market town with a famed Desele's House of Earthly Delights, a hub for slave-running and Camonna Tong enforcers dressed as caravan guards.

demographics.primary: Hlaalu slavers' agents, Camonna Tong runners, tavern gossips

nodes.customNotes: Hlaalu market town with a famed Desele's House of Earthly Delights, a hub for slave-running and Camonna Tong enforcers dressed as caravan guards.

nodes.name: Molag Mar
nodes.description: Temple-capital of the Molag Amur coast, a lava-ringed stone town whose Waistworks and cantons shelter pilgrims and the memory of Ald Sotha.

demographics.primary: Temple scholars, Redoran warriors, Hlaalu witnesses

nodes.customNotes: Temple-capital of the Molag Amur coast, a lava-ringed stone town whose Waistworks and cantons shelter pilgrims and the memory of Ald Sotha.

nodes.name: Tel Fyr
nodes.description: Basalt-tower island of Divayth Fyr, immortal Telvanni wizard, whose cellars hold the Corprusarium and the scholar-ghost of Yagrum Bagarn.

demographics.primary: Telvanni wizard-lord retainers, corprus patients, Dwemer scholars

nodes.customNotes: Basalt-tower island of Divayth Fyr, immortal Telvanni wizard, whose cellars hold the Corprusarium and the scholar-ghost of Yagrum Bagarn.

nodes.name: Holamayan Monastery
nodes.description: Island monastery of the Tribunal's dissident priests, a library of banned prophecy tucked into the volcanic coast.

demographics.primary: Dissident Temple monks, Ordinator exiles, hermit scribes

nodes.customNotes: Island monastery of the Tribunal's dissident priests, a library of banned prophecy tucked into the volcanic coast.

nodes.name: Erabenimsun Camp
nodes.description: Hardline warrior tribe of the Molag Amur ash-flats whose Ashkhan resents outsiders and the Temple's claim to Nerevar's shadow.

demographics.primary: Erabenimsun Ashlanders, hunters, blood-oath warriors

nodes.customNotes: Hardline warrior tribe of the Molag Amur ash-flats whose Ashkhan resents outsiders and the Temple's claim to Nerevar's shadow.

nodes.name: Ahemmusa Camp
nodes.description: Smallest and most open of the four great tribes, living in the ash-grass of the Grazelands and respected for its peace-weaving Ashkhan.

demographics.primary: Ahemmusa Ashlanders, guar herders, scouts

nodes.customNotes: Smallest and most open of the four great tribes, living in the ash-grass of the Grazelands and respected for its peace-weaving Ashkhan.

nodes.name: Dagon Fel
nodes.description: Northern harbor of Sheogorad, a rain-lashed Nordic frontier town whose pub gossip is the best map of the northern sea.

demographics.primary: Nord-descended sailors, Dunmer fishers, Redoran garrison

nodes.customNotes: Northern harbor of Sheogorad, a rain-lashed Nordic frontier town whose pub gossip is the best map of the northern sea.

nodes.name: Vos
nodes.description: Telvanni-tied town and Temple shrine perched on cliffs; the Vos Chapel hosts the Temple's relics of Saint Aralor.

demographics.primary: Telvanni wizards' servants, Temple scribes, Grazeland herders

nodes.customNotes: Telvanni-tied town and Temple shrine perched on cliffs; the Vos Chapel hosts the Temple's relics of Saint Aralor.

nodes.name: Tel Mora
nodes.description: Mushroom-tower hamlet of the Telvanni coast, ruled by capricious Mouth of the house and flush with enchanters.

demographics.primary: Telvanni apprentices, mushroom-tower servants, mage retainers

nodes.customNotes: Mushroom-tower hamlet of the Telvanni coast, ruled by capricious Mouth of the house and flush with enchanters.

nodes.name: Tel Aruhn
nodes.description: Telvanni tower-town where Wizard-Lords hold their slow plots and apprentice mages run errands that border on treason.

demographics.primary: Telvanni apprentices, slave-owners, Mages Guild envoys

nodes.customNotes: Telvanni tower-town where Wizard-Lords hold their slow plots and apprentice mages run errands that border on treason.

nodes.name: Sadrith Mora
nodes.description: Telvanni capital and eastern gateway to Vvardenfell, home to Tel Naga and the Wolverine Hall Legion garrison; its council plots over who will inherit the tower-lords' empire.

demographics.primary: Telvanni wizard-lords, Imperial Wayfarers, Mages Guild teachers

nodes.customNotes: Telvanni capital and eastern gateway to Vvardenfell, home to Tel Naga and the Wolverine Hall Legion garrison; its council plots over who will inherit the tower-lords' empire.

nodes.name: Fort Buckmoth
nodes.description: Imperial Legion fort overlooking the Ald'ruhn road; its sergeants complain more of Ashlander raiders than of blight.

demographics.primary: Legion legionaries, Imperial officers, supply clerks

nodes.customNotes: Imperial Legion fort overlooking the Ald'ruhn road; its sergeants complain more of Ashlander raiders than of blight.
